why: Skills EXCLUDED from a promotion batch by owner ruling, with the measured reason each one is out. This register is what makes a partial promotion describable: promote-skills refuses to promote a subset of a batch because "promoting the passing subset would leave the corpus half live, with no single description of what is retrievable" — this file IS that description, so the runner selects against it instead of refusing. Nothing here is deleted, waived or downgraded: every held skill is still judged in full, its verdict is still written to the promotion report, and it returns to the batch automatically the moment its entry is removed.
ruling: OWNER DECISION 2026-08-27, PROMOTION-SCOPE option B — re-scope the batch to the 62 that pass RESOLVABLE_ABOVE_FLOOR. The remaining 34 must NOT be waived, deleted or promoted; they are recorded here as HOLD / IMPROVEMENT QUEUE with their measured failure reasons so they can be improved and promoted later. The 0.75 floor, RESOLVABLE_ABOVE_FLOOR, NO_REGRESSION, EVAL_COVERED and every fail-closed behaviour are unchanged.
improvement_queue: docs/registers/taxonomy-decisions/corpus-improvement-candidates-2026-08-26.md — the same 34, with their gaps, and the GP-04 worked example showing one evidenced alias moved a skill 0.0555.
